name: Sanctions & coercion
value: US blockade of Iran; new OFAC listings
summary: US naval blockade of Iran continues; lifting it and sanctions is among Iran's conditions for a deal
state: The US naval blockade of Iranian ports remains in force while Iran reviews a Qatari bridge-deal proposal that would lift it and reopen Hormuz (gCaptain). OFAC has kept adding Iran-related designations aimed at oil transport networks (Gulf News). Secondary sanctions on Russia and Iran remain in place, and no major economy had been cut off from payment systems as of 7 Nov.
for_you: Firms trading with sanctioned jurisdictions face compliance risk; check official OFAC, EU and OFSI guidance.
rubric_hit: Major packages and blockade in force = Watch; no major economy cut off from payments (Alert)

why: Sanctions are now a frontline weapon; secondary sanctions and asset seizures fragment global finance and trade.
